Name: Parrot Parents - text and dialogue edits for kids to birds mod
Author: Rubecula
Description:
Made this to go with the adorable [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/309]Bird Replacements for Babies[/url]﻿ (for Content Patcher users, an unofficial conversion can be found [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/#post-3258948]here[/url]﻿). Ankokou's original mod does not include changes to:

[list]
[*]child/adoption prompts, generic pregnancy dialogue, etc. not found in the spouse dialogue files;
[*]spouse dialogues for Emily and Shane that refer to children, as they were added as spouse options later
[/list]
and I got tired of my wife talking about our nonexistent baby, so I made this to fix up the gaps. All text referring to the player and their spouse having a baby should now be changed to being about parrots, but let me know if you find any that I missed.

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

(Disclaimer: I am not affiliated with Ankokou in any way and had no part in making their original mod. This was made as a companion for the sake of completion and consistency, and no assets or modifications from the original mod are used in this file.)
